footer.description: KIZERE is a comprehensive digital platform for streamlined item registration, lost and found reporting, and intelligent ownership management.

notifications.itemMatchedDesc: A lost item matching your description has been found.

registration.title: Register Your Item
registration.subtitle: Protect your valuable possessions by registering them in our secure digital registry.
registration.item_register_subtitle: Register your item for safekeeping and recovery in case it gets lost

progress.title: Registration Progress
progress.subtitle: Complete all required sections to register your item.

payment.title: Registration Fee Information
payment.description: A registration fee of 2,000 RWF is required to complete the registration process. This fee helps us maintain the registry and provide secure identification services.
payment.redirect: You'll be redirected to our secure payment gateway after submitting this form.

idRecognition.title: Upload an image of your item's identification label
idRecognition.subtitle: Works with labels showing IMEI, serial numbers, or document IDs
idRecognition.alertDescription: Upload a clear image of your item's label, box, or documentation. The system will attempt to identify unique identifiers like IMEI, serial numbers, or document IDs automatically.

batchUpload.title: Upload Item Images
batchUpload.subtitle: Add multiple photos of your item from different angles. Clear photos help with identification.
batchUpload.fileTypes: Supports JPG, PNG, GIF up to
batchUpload.tips: Tips: Upload clear, well-lit photos from multiple angles. You can drag to reorder images, and the first image will be the main display image.

ownershipChain.title: Ownership Documentation
ownershipChain.subtitle: Create a verifiable chain of ownership with supporting documents
ownershipChain.alertDescription: Upload documents that prove your ownership of the item. This creates a verifiable ownership chain that can be useful in case of disputes or when selling the item. Start with the original purchase receipt and add subsequent documents in chronological order.

qrCode.title: QR Code Generator
qrCode.subtitle: Generate a unique QR code for your registered item
qrCode.needRegistration: Complete item registration to generate a QR code
qrCode.correctionInfo: Higher correction levels make QR codes more reliable but larger
qrCode.verifiedDesc: This QR code provides a quick way to verify this item's authenticity and check ownership details.
